text:
ana: Heads up — seeing a perf regression on Mistral-7B (8x7B variant) on the nightly perf suite after the kernel selector change. throughput down ~18% on long sequences.

carlos: ugh. observed where? end-to-end or just decode kernels?

ana: end-to-end p99 latency for 1-8 batch sizes, seq_len=2048, it spikes around steps where KV cache hits > 1500 tokens. looks like KV copy or windowing is thrashing.

liam: can you paste the profile flame?

ana: pasted below — it's the consolidated run for 8x7b, batch=4, seq=2048:

```
# top stacks
decode_step -> kv_cache_load(30%) -> attention_kernel_fallback(25%) -> cuda_memcpy(10%) -> other
flash_attn_kernel: 5% (used for short seqs)
triton_attn_kernel: 60% (used for longer seqs)
```

ana: looks like our selector picks triton for >1024 and ends up doing extra masking steps that blow up when we slide the window.

sara: is this new kernel benchmarking covering RoPE scaling edge cases? Mistral uses RoPE with 128 head dim scaling quirks.

carlos: yeah Mistral's RoPE impl and slightly different head_kv dims mean our generic rope_scaling heuristic mispredicts and we fall back to slower path. also attention mask handling when max_position_embeddings != runtime_seq triggers masked loops.

liam: I dug into the kernel selector PR — it chooses triton when seq*head_dim > threshold. For Mistral 8x7b head_dim is 128? That pushes it over. We probably should special-case Mistral7B to prefer flash_attn-like kernel for sliding windows up to 2048.

pm_leah: priority? this impacts Hosted API SLA for a handful of customers.

ana: triage: P1 for perf regression. short-term patch: force kernel override for Mistral-7B when sliding_window_kv=true and seq<=2048. Longer-term: improve heuristic with rope_scale and kv_dim awareness.

carlos: I tested a quick override on a dev pool — results: throughput back up ~14% and mem copies drop significantly. sample patch config:

```
model_overrides:
  mistral-7b:
    kernel_prefer: flash_attn
    sliding_window_kv: true
    rope_scaling: {type: 'linear', factor: 1.0}
    max_position_embeddings: 4096
```

liam: note: setting max_position_embeddings > model's trained max forces our attention mask to generate padded regions. We must ensure we don't enable RoPE extrapolation unless rope_scaling explicitly provided. Otherwise we can get small correctness drift.

sara: also watch kv shapes: Mistral's kv_dim vs head_dim mismatch sometimes causes our kernel to allocate temp buffers. we saw extra allocate/free churn in the profile. Fix: align kv_dim->head_dim mapping and avoid silent reshape.

ana: added profiling diff: before vs after override:

```
before: decode_step 1.0x baseline, kv_cache_load 0.3s, attention_kernel_fallback 0.5s
after: decode_step 0.86x, kv_cache_load 0.12s, flash_attn 0.22s
```

carlos: good. but patch is risky for Dedicated customers with locked quantization/compiled kernels. need feature flag.

liam: propose flow: 1) rollback kernel-selector change to canary, 2) ship model-specific override for mistral-7b on hosted canary, 3) add heuristic: consider (rope_scale, kv_dim, head_dim, sliding_window) before choosing kernel.

pm_leah: timeline?

ana: I can land the model override as a config change today behind FF. liam can follow up with selector fix and unit tests. Estimated: override in prod canary in 24h, selector fix in 5 days.

sara: test matrix we need: seq lengths [512,1024,1536,2048], batch [1,4,8], sliding_window true/false, rope_scaling variants [none, linear=0.5, linear=1.0]. also quantized int8 passes.

carlos: reminder: attention mask quirks — we saw a case where runtime_seq > model.max_position_embeddings and mask builder used modulo which created wrapped attention. please add assert if runtime_seq > max_position embeddings and rope_scaling not set.

liam: good catch. I'll add guard and a graceful fallback that returns explicit error unless override flag set.

dev-bot: deploy job started for config change (canary pool: redwood-canary-gpu-2) — job 98765

ana: canary metrics after 2h: p50 down 1.02x, p95 down 0.9x, token-cost unchanged. no errors surfaced.

pm_leah: thanks — please add a short postmortem note to eng-runtime when selector fix lands. include perf numbers and test matrix.

carlos: one more note: for Mixtral variants head_kv layout differs; we'll need separate overrides for mixtral-7b. I added an issue in infra board.

ana: putting the minimal override PR link here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/1234 — contains tests and canary FF key.

liam: assigned follow-up to me: refine selector with rope-aware scoring + add unit tests for attention_mask builder.

sara: thanks all. summary: root cause = kernel selector + rope/kv dimension mismatch causing fallback kernels and extra memcopies on sliding windows; mitigation = model override + selector improvements.

ana: cc @pm_leah — marking P1 -> in progress. :white_check_mark:
